Subject: SOC2 + ISO audit partner — RFP + renewal options

Hi Olivia,

Hope you're well. We're starting procurement for our annual SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 audit cycle (covering 2026 calendar year) and wanted to get SecureAudit's proposal and SOW options for vendor selection. Key items for this engagement:

- SOC 2 Type II (security + availability) — initial annual assessment + monitoring evidence collection
- ISO 27001 surveillance audit (scope: Redwood cloud services + control plane)
- Optional: readiness review / gap remediation support (hourly)
- Expected timeline: kickoff in mid-November, fieldwork late January 2026

Could you send your standard SOW, fee schedule (hourly and fixed options), sample contract terms (confidentiality, data handling, subprocessor policy), and estimated timeline? Also note we may require a separate statement about evidence storage/retention and access controls for auditors.

For context, internal stakeholders: Vivek (head of security), Rishi (legal), and Lauren (procurement/finance) will review — I'll loop them in after your reply.

Thanks — can you get something over by end of week?

Regards,
Monica Patel
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks Monica — quick read of the SOW and a couple of security asks:

1) Evidence retention: 90 days is not sufficient for our needs. We require 12 months retention for audit artifacts tied to SOC2 evidence. Please ask SecureAudit to include a contractual 12-month retention for our organization (encrypted at rest).

2) Key management: confirm that auditor access to evidence is via our KMS (customer-managed keys) or that SecureAudit stores artifacts in a KMS-protected bucket with role-based access. If they use their own encryption keys, we need an option to require HSM/KMS integration.

3) Subprocessor access & data minimization: ensure SOW states auditors will only store evidence necessary for the audit and will not copy source data beyond what's required; limit retention and require deletion confirmation.

4) Technical pre-audit: yes — schedule the 30-min slot. Prefer Wed 10/15 or Thu 10/16 PST for a short run-through with platform and SRE folks.

If SecureAudit is amenable to the 12-month retention and key-management language, I don't foresee further blockers. Rishi, please review liability and termination language.

-Vivek
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@secureaudit.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 16:42:00 -0700

Olivia — thanks for the quick turnaround. We've reviewed the draft and have two contract asks before we can move to signature: 12-month evidence retention (encrypted at rest) and explicit KMS/HSM integration (or option to require customer-managed keys). Our legal team (Rishi) will propose a small liability clarification but nothing material. Lauren confirmed budget.

If SecureAudit can update the SOW to reflect:
- Evidence retention: 12 months
- KMS/HSM key-management option: allow customer-managed keys or explicit HSM controls
- Data minimization clause: auditors will delete evidence not required for audit within 14 days of audit close and provide deletion confirmation
- Payment: 60% on kickoff, 40% on delivery of final reports

We're happy to move forward on the revised SOW. Please send an updated SOW and I'll circulate for signature. We'll use DocuSign for countersignature.

Next steps:
- Olivia to send SOW v2 with the above language (target EOD Fri 12 Sep)
- Schedule 30-min technical pre-audit (Olivia/Vivek) for week of Oct 13
- Lauren to create PO once SOW finalized

Thanks all — appreciated.

Monica Patel
